title: Runbook-Compensated Bugs
pattern: Code that raises high-priority alarms to request a human operator to perform a trivial, highly predictable cleanup action that could be executed programmatically.
why_bad: Creates severe alert fatigue, disrupts SRE focus, and introduces operational errors when automated self-healing scripts are trivial to implement [112-113].
detection: Predictable limit-exceeded states (such as cache full or queue full) triggering alert-routing mechanisms instead of purging routines.
fix: Automate the remediation path (such as oldest-first queue eviction or size-capped logging limits) directly within the code.
